test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following is/are NOT use(s) of washing soda?

(i) Manufacture of glass, soap and paper

(ii) In soda-acid fire extinguisher

(iii) For removing permanent hardness of water
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only ii.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• Washing soda is a frequent name for **sodium carbonate decahydrate**.
 
• It resembles a white **crystalline solid **in appearance.
 
• It has a **fundamental nature**.
 
• **Uses:**
 
 
• It's used in **laboratories **as a **reagent**.
 
• It is used to **eliminate stains**.
 
• It is used to remove the **lingering hardness **of the **water**.
 
• It is also used to **make paper **and **soap **in addition to **glass**.
 
• It is used in both the **refinement **of **oil and textiles. **
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information:__**

 
• In soda-acid fire extinguishers, **sodium bicarbonate** and **sulfuric **acid are both used.
 
• It is the best **fire extinguisher **to **use **at **home**.
 
• **Sulfuric acid **is included in a **separate bottle **along with **sodium bicarbonate **in **water solution **in the fire extinguisher.
 
• **Sulphuric acid combines **with **sodium bicarbonate solution** when fire extinguisher's **knob **is **turned**, resulting in production of a small amount of carbon dioxide gas.** **
